title: FLF High Flow Fuel Filter (12 ORB)
description: Finish Line Factory’s high flow inline fuel filters can be used for filtering fuel before or after the fuel pump to provide maximum protection for your fuel system. These can be easily disassembled for inspection and cleaning if necessary, and each filter uses a high-quality stainless steel mesh for maximum filtering capability and high flow, as well as a strong magnet to capture ferrous particles before they reach your injectors! The housing features -12 ORB inputs and outputs.
